guide: [[@2611.26358|Beam]] 的看点在后训练：1 亿条 rollout 的全异步 RL，两个专家用 [[mopd|MOPD]] 合并后学生反超教师；「省 3–4 倍算力」主要来自激活参数少，同表里 16B 激活的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 在 DeepSWE 上仍领先 30 个点。[[@2611.34529|AliceAI-Foundation]] 强项集中在俄语，可复用的是缩放律那一节：拟合超参前先确认验证集 loss 和下游排序一致，否则学习率会差出 60%。[[@2611.34579|Tune for Retention]] 提醒做领域 SFT 的人：别人报告遗忘 33 个点的设置，只调小学习率和 batch 遗忘就没了。

[[@2611.33893|并行 subagent 研究]]测出委派只多通过 1–5 个百分点的隐藏测试，成本最高到 3.8 倍，让单 agent 先探测参考程序就能拿回大部分收益。[[@2611.34147|模型自管上下文]]让模型自己决定何时压缩历史，GPT 6.1 在 32K 预算下得分接近原来的三倍。[[@2611.26863|幻觉记忆研究]]发现在知识任务上照搬推理式 RL，被奖励强化过的幻觉复述率上升 4.83%，未被强化的只有 0.17%。本期还有五篇循环（looped）模型，[[@2611.34821|LoopTitan]] 用匹配的非复用对照说明，参数复用本身几乎没带来收益，收益来自用专家数换层数。

funnel: 新论文（15 个 arXiv 分类 719 篇 + HF / HN 热门补充 150 篇）

papers.title: AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base
papers.title_zh: Yandex 开源 MoE 基座：训练集留出 loss 与下游排序只有 42% 一致
papers.summary_zh: Yandex 从零训练并以 Apache 2.0 开源的 80B 总参数、约 3B 激活参数 MoE 基座模型，结合 Kimi Delta Attention 与全注意力。
papers.abstract_zh: 我们发布 AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base：一个总参数 800 亿、每个 token 约激活 30 亿参数的 mixture-of-experts 语言模型，由 Yandex 从零训练，以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源。模型把 ==Kimi Delta Attention== 与全注意力结合，使用 Attention Residuals，并用 Muon 训练。训练包括 17.5T token 的通用预训练、两个上下文扩展阶段，以及一个专门面向推理和 Agent 交互的阶段。我们介绍了数据收集与增强流水线、评测协议、架构消融和缩放律实验。我们指出了把训练分布上的 ==held-out loss== 当作下游性能代理指标的局限，并提出在 mixture-of-experts 输出上加一项辅助损失，使模型能在预测的学习率下稳定训练。针对特定领域的数据筛选和增强提升了事实知识、数学和编程能力；预训练中引入的 Agent 轨迹在 SFT 后提升了 Agent benchmark 上的表现。在 zero-shot 推理评测中，该模型在同等规模的开源基座模型里成绩领先，**IMO-AnswerBench pass@8 为 88.7%，LiveCodeBench v5–v6 pass@8 为 82.9%**。为评测俄语事实知识，我们构建并发布了两个 benchmark 及其评测协议：WikiWebFacts 考察取自百科来源和搜索 query 的简短事实问题，HardMultiQA 考察受用户交互启发、要求更高的事实问题。**我们的模型在 WikiWebFacts 和 HardMultiQA 上分别得到 86.5% 和 67.9%**，DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base（总参数 284B、激活 13B）为 83.2% 和 65.4%，Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-Base（总参数 120B、激活 12B）为 72.8% 和 54.5%，在这两个 benchmark 上超过了这两个更大的模型。
papers.abstract_en: We present AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B-Base, a mixture-of-experts language model with 80 billion total parameters and approximately 3 billion active parameters per token, trained from scratch at Yandex and released under the Apache 2.0 license. The model combines Kimi Delta Attention with full attention, uses Attention Residuals, and is trained with Muon. Training comprises general pretraining on 17.5 trillion tokens, two context-extension stages, and a dedicated stage for reasoning and agentic interaction. We describe the data collection and augmentation pipelines, evaluation protocols, architectural ablations, and scaling-law experiments. We identify the limitations of held-out training loss as a proxy for downstream performance and introduce an auxiliary loss on mixture-of-experts outputs to stabilize training at the predicted learning rate. Domain-specific data selection and augmentation improve factual knowledge, mathematics, and programming skills, while agent trajectories introduced during pretraining improve performance on agentic benchmarks after supervised fine-tuning. In zero-shot reasoning evaluation, the model achieves leading results among open base models of comparable size, with 88.7% pass@8 on IMO-AnswerBench and 82.9% pass@8 on LiveCodeBench v5-v6. To evaluate Russian-language factual knowledge, we introduce and release two benchmarks with their evaluation protocols: WikiWebFacts, which tests short factual questions drawn from encyclopedic sources and search queries, and HardMultiQA, which tests more demanding factual questions inspired by user interactions. Our model scores 86.5% on WikiWebFacts and 67.9% on HardMultiQA, compared with 83.2% and 65.4% for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base (284B total and 13B active parameters) and 72.8% and 54.5% for Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-Base (120B total and 12B active parameters), outperforming both larger models on these benchmarks.
analysis: Yandex 从零训练并以 Apache 2.0 开源了 80B 总参数、约 3B 激活参数的 MoE 基座。俄语事实问答 HardMultiQA 上它拿到 67.9%，高于激活参数多 4 倍的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base（65.4%）；但英文 TriviaQA 只有 79.0%，落后后者 10 个点，**强项集中在俄语知识**。报告更有用的部分是一份逐项拆开的配方：从 Qwen3-Next 基线出发，依次换数据、架构、超参，每个配置都在 2T token 上从零训，宏平均从 63.0 依次升到 66.9、68.6、69.1，数据贡献最大。

模型 48 层里 36 层用 [[kimi-delta-attention|KDA]]、12 层用全注意力（3:1 交替），残差求和换成 ==Attention Residuals==（每个 token 用 softmax 对前面各层输出加权），优化器是 [[muon|Muon]]。训练分四段：8K 上下文通用预训练 17.5T token，32K、256K 两段扩上下文，最后 280B token 的 ==推理阶段==（长推理轨迹加工具调用轨迹）。按缩放律预测的学习率会让 MoE down-projection 输出持续变大、随后 loss 尖峰；router 的 Z-loss、截断 SwiGLU 都没解决，最后对 MoE 输出本身加 [[z-loss|Z-loss]]，没有额外训练开销。

最值得记住的是缩放律那一节：用训练分布的留出集算 loss 时，候选配置按 loss 的排序和按下游均分的排序只有 42% 一致；换成挑过的代码集、benchmark 集后升到 93–94%，预测学习率也从 5.1e-4 变成 8.2e-4。**超参缩放律的结论取决于拿什么数据量 loss**。另外两条：推理数据混进通用语料不如集中放在最后单独一段，HMMT pass@32 由此从 24.3% 升到 96.9%；在短跑续训里有效的事实增强，放进 17.5T 的长训练后收益消失，作者归因于有用事实的出现频率被稀释，于是把增强扩大到约 30% 的事实网页才拿回约 5 个点。

保留意见：推理成绩是 base 模型 zero-shot 的 pass@32、pass@8，而它的推理阶段已经喂过大量长轨迹，和没有这一阶段的对手不在同一起跑线（DeepSeek-V4-Flash 在这个设置下接近 0 分，被直接剔除），报告也没给 RL 之后的 pass@1 对比。对做预训练和中训练的团队，可以直接照搬两件事：拟合超参缩放律前，先检验验证集 loss 和下游排序是否一致；推理和 Agent 数据集中放到最后一段。
star_reasons: 大厂从零训练的开源 MoE 基座技术报告，Apache 2.0 权重加两个俄语事实 benchmark
数据、架构、超参三项各在 2T token 上从零训做顺序消融，配方可复用
实测训练分布留出 loss 与下游排序一致率仅 42%，改变缩放律拟合的常见做法
给出 MoE 输出 Z-loss 稳定训练、推理阶段单独放最后等可直接照搬的经验

figures.caption_zh: MoE down-projection 输出范数随训练的变化：不加 [[z-loss|Z-loss]] 的曲线持续上升，随后会出现 loss 尖峰；加在 MoE 输出上的 Z-loss 把它压平，且**没有观察到 benchmark 下降**。
往事实问题里塞入不含答案的干扰文档后的准确率。只用文档问答类长上下文合成数据时，干扰让分数相对下降 30–40%；加入带无关上下文的问答训练后降幅缩到约 10%。
带搜索的小模型能答对的事实，其有用网页在训练语料里的去向：只有 35% 留到最终语料，24% 被过滤器丢掉，41% 根本没抓到。这是作者把事实网页单独做成一类语料的起点。
==MaRS== 数学推理数据的漏斗：约 140B 篇预过滤文档抽出 9.8 亿道题，按难度、题型、多数投票层层筛选后只剩约 100 万道带解答的题。

papers.title: Beam Model Technical Report
papers.title_zh: Reflection 开源 Beam：RL 跑了 1 亿条 rollout 仍未见顶
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏 MoE 模型 Beam 总参数 501.3B、激活 23.4B，面向代码、推理和 Agent 场景，预训练 23.8T token。
papers.abstract_zh: Beam 是一个稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型，总参数 501.3B、激活参数 23.4B，专门为代码、推理和 Agent 类负载构建和优化。Beam 提供前沿水平的推理能力，同时所需推理算力比许多同级别模型少 3–4 倍。Beam 在 23.8T 多样、精选的高质量 token 上预训练，并通过新颖的==两阶段中训==获得 1M token 的上下文窗口，中训数据可验证、以正确性为锚点。后训练依托一次大规模、==全异步强化学习（RL）==：在 10.5K 张 GB300 GPU 上训练 4 周，生成超过 1 亿条 rollout。我们认为这是迄今开放实验室进行过的规模最大的 RL 训练之一。**在我们的评测集上，能力随 RL 算力增加持续提升，没有出现平台期。**借助深度的软硬件协同设计、FP8/NVFP4 量化，以及一个 1.93B 参数的投机解码 drafter（==DFlash 2==），Beam 最大化了服务吞吐，部署高效灵活。在各对话轮次和危害类别上取平均，**Beam 对 88.9% 的有害请求拒绝或转向，同时对 81.5% 的无害请求予以响应**，在位于 Pareto 前沿的开源权重模型中，对有害请求的拒绝/转向率最高。
papers.abstract_en: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.
analysis: Beam 是 Reflection 的第一个开源权重模型：501B 总参数、23.4B 激活的 MoE（Mixture-of-Experts，每个 token 只走 256 个专家里的 8 个），SWE-bench Verified 81.6、Terminal-Bench v2.1 80.1，和激活 40B 的 GLM 5.2 基本打平。报告最重的主张在后训练：10.5K 张 GB300 上跑了 4 周、超过 1 亿条 rollout 的全异步 RL，held-out 指标一路上涨，**作者称没有出现平台期**。

预训练 23.8T token，代码和 STEM 合计约六成；每项改动都要在 300M 到 6B 的 ==scaling ladder==（一组逐级放大的小模型）上测算力效率，提升超过 5% 才采纳。中训分两段：先用 850B token 在 32K 长度上灌入可验证的推理、代码和终端数据，再用 100B token 扩到 512K。后训练分别训一个 agentic 专家和一个 alignment 专家，再用 [[mopd|多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）]] 合成一个模型：学生自己采样，按任务类型抽一位教师给出全词表逆 KL，==不用任何外部 reward==。RL 采用 [[grpo|GRPO]] 式目标，配合 [[routing-replay|路由回放]]，并让 judge 复查通过测试的 SWE 补丁，判为 reward hacking 就记 0 分。

正文里比摘要更有信息量的是三组观察。RL 中途有两段只训单一领域（26%–52% 只练数学和竞赛编程，52%–65% 只练 SWE），另一侧的指标都没退化；从没训过搜索任务时，BrowseComp 也从 50.1 涨到 57.9。合并后的学生在 SWE-Bench Pro 上拿到 67.1，**反超 agentic 教师的 62.2**，但 DeepSWE 掉了 3.2 分。把 alignment 教师从 100B 换成 501B、数据和配方不变，过度拒绝相对减少 48.7%，代价是对有害请求的拦截率下降 3.1%。

**「推理算力省 3–4 倍」主要是激活参数少带来的**：同一张表里激活只有 16B 的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，在 DeepSWE（74.2 对 43.3）和 Terminal-Bench（90.6 对 80.1）上都领先，所以 Beam 并不是同等算力下最强的。base 模型 AIME 2026 拿到 63.7、DeepSeek V4 Pro Base 只有 1.9，这也是中训灌了推理数据造成的，两边并不对等。「没有平台期」只有一次 run 的曲线，没给算力和分数的拟合。做后训练的团队可以直接参考「专家分开训、再用 MOPD 合并」的做法，以及全词表逆 KL 的分块实现；部署方可以用 NVFP4 版本（保留 98.98% 中位分数）加 DFlash 2 drafter，解码速度提高 1.9–3.0 倍。
star_reasons: 西方实验室的 500B 级开源权重技术报告，预训练、中训、RL、蒸馏合并、量化和投机解码全链路都有细节
1 亿条 rollout 的全异步 RL，给出了训练–推理 KL、策略陈旧度和分领域迁移的实测数据
多教师在线蒸馏合并两个专家，学生在多项 agentic coding 指标上反超教师，并检查了「split-brain」失效模式
安全部分给出了扩大教师规模对过度拒绝的定量影响（相对减少 48.7%）

figures.caption_zh: RL 过程中 8 个 held-out 基准随训练进度的变化。浅色阴影段只训数学、STEM 和竞赛编程，深色段只训 SWE，两段里另一侧指标都没掉；BrowseComp 在 83% 之前没有训过搜索任务，也从 50.1 涨到 57.9。
DeepSWE pass@1 对每个 episode 平均输出 token 数，每条曲线是一个 RL checkpoint（越深越晚），每个点是一档 reasoning effort。先看同样分数下 token 变少，再看后期 checkpoint 加大 effort 后分数还在涨。
[[mopd|MOPD]] 的结构：学生采样回答，按 Bernoulli 概率选 agentic 或 alignment 教师，最小化学生对教师的逆 KL。STEM、代码、搜索全给 agentic 教师，安全和对话风格全给 alignment 教师，指令遵循各占一半。
代码和网页验证集上的 loss 对训练 FLOPs：scaling ladder 跨 4 个数量级落在一条线上，Beam Base（大圆点）落在预测位置，并在同等算力下低于 DeepSeek V4 Flash Base 和 Nemotron 3 Ultra Base。
base 模型的 RULER 分数随输入长度变化。中训最长只到 512K，Beam 在 1M 上依然领先 MiMo-V2.5-Pro 和 Nemotron 3 Ultra。

papers.title: Tune for Retention, Not Just Gain: SFT Forgets Far Less than You Think
papers.title_zh: SFT 遗忘多半怪超参：调小学习率和 batch，掉分从 33 点变 0
papers.summary_zh: 指出SFT的灾难性遗忘远小于普遍认为的程度，挑战在线策略方法更少遗忘的说法。
papers.abstract_zh: ==灾难性遗忘==（在学习新能力时大幅丢失已有能力）是语言模型微调的核心难题。人们普遍认为监督微调（SFT）容易出现这种遗忘。近期工作把原因归到 SFT 的 off-policy 性质，认为 on-policy 学习是持续学习的关键。本文对这一前提提出质疑。我们发现，以最大化新任务表现为目标确实可能引发灾难性遗忘，但换一组超参数（**更低的学习率和更小的 batch size**）可以在取得相近收益的同时几乎不遗忘。在==同时兼顾收益与保留==来选择超参数时，普通 SFT 保留已有能力的程度远好于此前的报道，并能与专为缓解遗忘设计的 on-policy 方法==自蒸馏微调（SDFT）==相竞争。SDFT 对超参数选择可能更稳健，但它同样需要一个考虑保留的准则，才能找出避免灾难性遗忘的超参数配置。我们的结果挑战了「on-policy 训练才是边学边保留的原因」这一观点，并引出更广泛的问题：微调过程中究竟是什么导致了灾难性遗忘。
papers.abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting, the drastic loss of previously acquired capabilities when learning new ones, is a central challenge in language model fine-tuning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely believed to be prone to such forgetting. Recent works have attributed this to the off-policy nature of SFT, arguing that on-policy learning is key to continual learning. In this paper, we challenge this premise. We show that while maximizing new-task performance can induce catastrophic forgetting, alternative hyperparameter choices (lower learning rate and batch size) can yield similar gains with little to no forgetting. With hyperparameters selected jointly for gain and retention, vanilla SFT retains prior capabilities far better than previously suggested and can be competitive with Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT), an on-policy approach designed to mitigate forgetting. While SDFT can be more robust to hyperparameter choices, it also requires a retention-aware criterion to identify hyperparameter configurations that avoid catastrophic forgetting. Our results challenge the view that on-policy training is what enables learning with retention and raise broader questions about what drives catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning.
analysis: SFT（监督微调）真的会[[catastrophic-forgetting|灾难性遗忘]]吗？近期工作把原因归到 SFT 是[[on-policy|off-policy]]训练，主张 on-policy 方法才能边学边不忘。这篇的回答是：**大部分遗忘来自超参数，不是 SFT 本身**。在 Chen 等人遗忘最严重的设置里（Llama-3.1-8B 在 MMLU 上微调），原配置（学习率 5e-5、batch 128）让旧能力平均掉 33.00 个点；只把学习率降到 1e-5、batch 降到 16，旧能力反而升了 0.55 个点，新任务涨幅也从 9.34 升到 12.13 个点，和 [[grpo|GRPO]] 的 11.95 持平。

做法是在 Qwen2.5-7B 上用三个新任务（化学选择题 Science、工具调用 ToolUse、美国律师考试题 MBE）做完整扫参：学习率 5e-6 到 1e-4、batch 16/32/64，固定训 2 个 epoch，旧能力用代码、指令遵循、数学、安全等 9 类评测的平均分衡量。选 checkpoint 时用==联合效用==：新任务涨幅加上旧能力变化量，在验证集上取最大。对照组是 [[sdft|SDFT]]，一种用示范答案做条件的自蒸馏 on-policy 方法。

按联合效用选出的 SFT 在 Science（33.2 对 33.8）和 ToolUse（25.8 对 26.4）上与 SDFT 打平，只在 MBE 上明显落后（13.4 对 21.3）。如果只看新任务分数选参，SFT 在 Science 上多涨 2.2 个点，却多忘 7.1 个点；SDFT 对超参更稳，但**同样需要把保留算进选参标准**，否则在 MBE 上也会白丢 3.1 个点。掉分主要集中在生成类评测（IFEval、代码、数学、越狱防御），选择题类基本不动。成本方面，用 MMLU、MATH、WildGuardTest 三项代替全部 9 类做验证，能选出和全套评测完全相同的配置；再按「掉分超过 2 个点就降学习率」做二分搜索，评测的配置数减少 81%。

保留意见：实验只覆盖 Qwen2.5 7B/14B 和 Llama 1B/8B 的全参数微调，新任务训练集都很小（ToolUse 只有 97 道评测题，同时用于选参和报告），没有测 LoRA 和更大规模的领域数据。作者也没找到不依赖旧能力评测的预警信号，参数漂移、训练 loss 都区分不出会遗忘的配置。对做领域 SFT 的人，实际含义是：先从小学习率、小 batch 扫起，并在验证时固定跑几项旧能力评测；想换 on-policy 方法来解决遗忘之前，先把 SFT 基线按保留重新调一遍。
star_reasons: 直接挑战「SFT 因 off-policy 而遗忘、on-policy 才能不忘」的流行结论
复现两篇代表性工作的设置，只改学习率和 batch 就让 33 个点的遗忘消失
给出低成本的保留感知调参做法：3 项验证评测 + 学习率二分搜索，评测量减少 81%

figures.caption_zh: Llama-3.1-8B 在 MMLU 上微调：横轴是新任务涨幅，纵轴是旧能力变化。原 SFT 配置掉 33 个点，**换成小学习率、小 batch 后的 SFT 落在 GRPO 旁边**，涨得更多且几乎不忘。
Qwen2.5-7B 上 SFT 的学习率扫描：绿色区域是新任务分数离最佳不到 3 个点的学习率，区域内旧能力掉分从不到 2 个点到超过 12 个点都有，**只看新任务选参很容易落进灾难性遗忘区**。
三个任务上 SFT 与 SDFT 在三种选参标准下的位置：Science 和 ToolUse 两者几乎重合，MBE 上 SDFT 在保留上更占优。
顺序微调 Science→ToolUse：只把 ToolUse 阶段的学习率降到 1e-5、batch 降到 16，SFT 学会 ToolUse 的同时保住了 Science 和通用能力，表现与 SDFT 相当。
Science 微调：SFT 和 SDFT 都存在涨幅相近、遗忘程度从灾难性到几乎为零的不同配置。

papers.title: Building a Unified Inline Code Editing Model for GitHub Copilot
papers.title_zh: 为 GitHub Copilot 构建统一的行内代码编辑模型
papers.summary_zh: 介绍 GitHub Copilot 中预测开发者下一处编辑的统一行内编辑模型的构建过程。
papers.abstract_zh: AI 辅助编程的范围从完全 agentic 的编程到编辑器中的行内建议。行内建议需要根据一次编辑会话预测开发者最可能的下一处编辑。下一处编辑可能在光标处、附近几行，或更远的位置，一个编辑意图也可能横跨其中几处。此前的系统按固定顺序查询彼此独立的补全、附近编辑和远距离编辑模型，各自有不同的输出格式；因此它无法在一次响应中表达跨越远距离位置的意图，每条建议可能需要多次串行模型调用，并且即使修正更合适时也优先给出补全。我们提出一个统一模型，在同一个输出空间中预测这三类编辑：一系列带锚点的 diff patch，指明位置、删除的行和新增的行。这种表示允许一次响应包含多处编辑，因此客户端可以从缓存中提供后续编辑，而无需再次调用模型。我们分两个阶段训练该模型，先统一下一处编辑与远距离编辑预测，再加入代码补全。我们通过模型伪标注和编辑历史回放，从单处编辑数据合成多处编辑监督信号。我们使用二值的 LLM 评分奖励、在数据过滤、奖励和评测中共用的 patch 有效性分类体系，以及针对特定失败模式的 grader boosting。第二阶段还调整了客户端处理和展示模型输出的方式。在 GitHub Copilot 的受控在线 A/B 实验中，相对于三模型基线，**第一阶段将显示时间显著缩短 6.77%，输出 token 减少 58.93%**。在第二阶段，3-in-1 模型加上客户端适配，相对于 2-in-1 模型搭配补全模型，**将每位用户被忽略的建议减少了 10.06%**。在整份报告中，我们还分享了评测、训练以及端到端模型与系统设计方面的方法和经验。
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted coding ranges from fully agentic coding to inline code suggestions in the editor. Inline suggestions require predicting a developer's most likely next edit from an editing session. The next edit may lie at the cursor, in nearby lines, or farther away, and one editing intent can span several of these. The preceding system queries separate completion, nearby edit, and long-distance edit models, each with its own output format, in a fixed sequence; it thus cannot express intents spanning distant locations in one response, can require several sequential model calls per suggestion, and prioritizes completion even when a correction would serve better. We present a unified model that predicts all three edit types in one output space: a sequence of anchored diff patches specifying locations, deleted lines, and added lines. This representation permits multiple edits per response, so the client can serve later edits from a cache without further model calls. We train this model in two phases, first unifying next edit and long-distance edit prediction, then adding code completion. We synthesize multi-edit supervision from single-edit data via model pseudolabeling and edit history playback. We use a binary LLM-graded reward, a patch validity taxonomy shared by data filtering, reward, and evaluation, and grader boosting for targeted failure modes. Phase 2 also adapts how the client processes and presents model outputs. In controlled online A/B experiments in GitHub Copilot, Phase 1 significantly reduces time to display by 6.77% and output tokens by 58.93% relative to the three-model baseline. In Phase 2, the 3-in-1 model and client adaptations reduce dismissed suggestions per user by 10.06% relative to the 2-in-1 model paired with the completion model. Throughout this report, we also share our methodology and learnings in evaluation, training, and end-to-end model and system design.

papers.title: When Are Parallel Subagents Effective for Coding? An Empirical Study on Repository Construction
papers.title_zh: 并行子智能体何时对编程有效？仓库构建的实证研究
papers.summary_zh: 对比单智能体与并行子智能体在按规格构建完整程序任务上的效果与成本。
papers.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的编码 agent 越来越多地用于长程任务，例如根据规格说明构建整个程序。Codex 和 Claude Code 等产品允许 agent 把工作委派给并行 subagent，这会成倍增加运行成本，但委派是否以及何时能产出更好的程序仍不清楚。我们在 NL2Repo 和 ProgramBench（后者还提供可执行的参考程序）的仓库构建任务上，比较单个 agent 与委派给 subagent 的主 agent。我们在相同时间和相同成本下比较得分，做干预实验，并分析细粒度行为。在随机抽取的任务上，**并行 subagent 只把隐藏测试通过率提高约 1 到 5 个百分点，成本却最高达单个 agent 的 3.8 倍**。其收益在困难任务上更大，我们发现了三种机制的证据。自检：在 GPT-5.6 Sol 上，用一句话让单个 agent 先探测参考程序，就能以很小的成本恢复这部分收益的大部分；从 GPT-5.6 Sol 到 GPT-6.1 Sol，随着单个 agent 更多地检查自己的工作，收益缩小。新鲜上下文：在长时间运行中，单个 agent 定期以空对话开启新会话，在每组比较中早期进展都比延续原对话的 agent 更快。模块化：多 agent 运行产出的代码更模块化（文件更多、函数更短），更接近上游源码。我们在 Claude Code 上用 Opus 5.5 做了较小的复现，观察到类似的模式。总体而言，subagent 在以下情况有帮助：（i）单个 agent 过早停止检查，（ii）长会话持续编辑却几乎没有改进，或（iii）模块化代码对任务有益；否则，它们主要增加成本。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based coding agents are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks such as building an entire program from a specification. Products like Codex and Claude Code let an agent delegate work to parallel subagents, multiplying run cost, yet it remains unclear whether and when delegation produces a better program. We compare a single agent with a main agent delegating to subagents on repository-construction tasks from NL2Repo and ProgramBench (which also provides an executable reference program). We compare scores at equal time and equal cost, run intervention experiments, and analyze fine-grained behavior. On randomly drawn tasks, parallel subagents raise hidden-test pass rates by only about 1 to 5 percentage points at up to 3.8x the cost of a single agent. Their gain is larger on hard tasks, where we find evidence of three mechanisms. Self-checking: with GPT-5.6 Sol, one sentence telling a single agent to probe the reference program first recovers most of this gain at a fraction of the cost; from GPT-5.6 Sol to GPT-6.1 Sol, the gain shrinks as single agents check their own work more. Fresh context: in extended runs, a single agent that periodically starts a new session with an empty conversation makes faster early progress in every comparison than one that resumes its conversation. Modularity: multi-agent runs produce more modular code (more files and shorter functions), closer to the upstream source. We observe similar patterns in a smaller replication with Opus 5.5 on Claude Code. Overall, subagents help when (i) a single agent stops checking too early, (ii) a long session keeps editing with little improvement, or (iii) modular code helps on the task; otherwise, they mainly add cost.

papers.title: LoopTitan: What Does Parameter Revisit Buy a Mixture-of-Experts?
papers.title_zh: LoopTitan：参数重访能为混合专家模型带来什么？
papers.summary_zh: 在匹配参数、FLOPs 和 KV cache 的条件下，拆开循环 MoE 报告的收益中被混淆的因素。
papers.abstract_zh: Looped Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）架构在不同深度上重复使用层参数，从而在不增加参数量的前提下提高有效深度。近期的 looped MoE 研究报告称，在参数量、FLOPs 和 KV cache 都相同的预算下，其相对标准 MoE 有明显收益。然而，这些收益仍然把参数复用与其他设计选择（如网络形状、residual scale）混在一起。我们要问的是：==参数复用==本身究竟带来了什么？通过匹配的非复用对照，我们发现参数复用本身几乎没有带来任何收益。我们认为，复用只提供了 MoE 本来就有的一种自由度，即在参数量固定时用专家数换深度（层数更多，每层专家更少）。首先，在预算匹配的条件下，我们对最先进的 looped 方案做了分解，最后才拆掉复用：非复用对照保留了全部收益，其中大部分来自网络形状，其余来自 residual scale。我们证明了这个 scale 等效于降低被复用层的学习率。它在 AdamW 各层步长不均匀的情况下有帮助，但在各层步长几乎相等的 Muon 下就不再有效。其次，在预算匹配之外，我们通过在固定参数量下增加计算量来评估复用。多访问一次所带来的收益超过把专家数翻倍。但在 Muon 下，不做复用、参数量和计算量都相同的更深标准 MoE，**也能拿到这部分收益的 90.2%**。总体而言，收益来自网络形状、优化器和额外计算，标准 MoE 都可以采用。据此我们提出 LoopTitan-Base 作为更强的 MoE 基线：在 Muon 下，它不用复用也不用 residual scale，就能与最强的 looped 方案持平。我们开源了 LoopTitan，并发布了 17 个预训练模型（包括 LoopTitan-Base 和对照模型）。实验记录以 GitHub issue 的形式公开，预测均为预先登记，完整的探索历史也予以保留。这是我们的第一阶段技术报告，为后续研究打下基础。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures revisit layer parameters across depths. This design increases effective depth without adding parameters. Recent looped MoE studies report substantial gains over the standard MoE at matched budgets (parameters, FLOPs and KV cache). However, the reported gains still confound parameter revisit with other design choices, e.g., network shape and residual scale. We ask, what does parameter revisit itself buy? Using matched non-revisit controls, we find that parameter revisit itself buys almost nothing. We argue that revisit only offers a freedom an MoE already has, i.e., trading experts for depth (more layers, fewer experts each) at fixed parameters. First, at matched budgets, we decompose the state-of-the-art looped recipe, with revisit last. A non-revisit control retains all the gain. Most comes from network shape, and the rest from residual scale. We prove this scale acts as a lower learning rate on revisited layers. This helps under AdamW's uneven layer step sizes, but disappears under Muon, which keeps them nearly equal. Second, beyond matched budgets, we evaluate revisit by adding compute at fixed parameters. One extra visit gains more than doubling the experts. Yet without revisit, a deeper standard MoE at equal parameters and compute obtains 90.2% of that gain under Muon. Overall, gains come from network shape, the optimizer and added compute, which a standard MoE can adopt. Accordingly, we propose LoopTitan-Base as a stronger MoE baseline. Under Muon, it matches the strongest looped recipe without revisit or residual scale. We open-source LoopTitan and release 17 pretrained models (including LoopTitan-Base and the control). Our experiment record is public as GitHub issues, with predictions pre-registered and the full exploration history kept. This is our Phase 1 technical report, laying the foundation for follow-up studies.

papers.title: Looped Models are Fast Multi-Token Predictors
papers.title_zh: 循环模型是快速的多 token 预测器
papers.summary_zh: 利用循环语言模型调整循环次数的特性，加速多 token 预测与自推测解码。
papers.abstract_zh: Looped 语言模型可以通过调整循环次数来调节预测每个 token 的计算量，而不必按比例增加独有的模型参数。这一性质已被用于 self-speculative decoding：用浅循环作为快速 drafter，用深循环做验证。由于 drafting 仍使用全部参数，这种做法是有效的。本文表明，浅循环还能预测未来的多个 token，并借此大幅加速 looped 语言模型的推理。为此我们提出 Floodgates，一种简单的 self-speculative decoding 方法：在序列末尾追加一段 mask token，并通过 low-rank adaptation 学习并行 draft 这些 token。在七个模型、五个基准、多种 batch size 以及 greedy 和采样解码下，==Floodgates== 在多数情况下是最快的无损解码方法，**加速最高达 7.5 倍**。分析表明，这一加速得益于 looped 模型的全深度训练，以及浅层 drafter 以验证阶段算出的深层前缀 cache 为条件、从而利用全深度计算的能力。
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models can adapt computation for predicting a token without a proportional rescaling in unique model parameters by adjusting the number of loops. This property has been used for self-speculative decoding, taking shallow loops as fast drafters and deep loops as verifiers, which is effective since drafting still uses full parameters. In this paper, we show that shallow loops can be also predictive of several future tokens and leverage this to drastically accelerate the inference of looped language models. To that end, we present Floodgates, a simple self-speculative decoding method that appends a block of mask tokens as a suffix and learns via low-rank adaptation to draft these tokens in parallel. Across seven models, five benchmarks, a range of batch sizes, and both greedy and sampled decoding, Floodgates is the fastest lossless decoding method in most cases, attaining up to 7.5x acceleration. Through analysis, we show that this speedup is enabled by all-depth training of looped models, with the shallow drafter's ability to leverage full-depth computation by conditioning on deep prefix cache evaluated during verification.

papers.title: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training
papers.title_zh: LLM 在后训练中记住了自己的幻觉
papers.summary_zh: 研究把以推理为中心的后训练配方（结果奖励 RL、认知行为注入等）直接用于其他领域带来的后果。
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管前沿模型在数学和代码之外的领域训练和部署，它们的后训练方案仍然是由推理领域塑造的。本文研究把以推理为中心的训练方案直接用于知识任务的后果，例如使用基于结果的奖励做强化学习（RL），以及注入“认知”行为（如在推理链中提出假设并回溯）等。我们假设，这些做法虽然对推理有用，但在知识任务上训练时，会让模型无意间记住自己在长推理链中生成的幻觉。为验证这一点，我们用标准后训练方法训练模型，提取其在 RL 期间自己生成的幻觉，并在后续训练中追踪记忆情况。我们在两个模型系列、两种架构的六个开源模型上进行实验，证实了这一假设。训练中被强化的幻觉，模型对其的复述率平均上升 4.83%，而没有得到训练信号的自生成幻觉仅上升 0.17%。模型甚至会记住自己在推理中随即撤回的错误事实，而这种回溯模板继承自以推理为中心的训练，对知识回忆没有任何帮助。此外，我们发现记忆在最难的训练问题上最强，而奖励一个幻觉会使模型之后更不容易对它选择弃答（平均降低 7.23%）。总体而言，我们的工作识别并系统研究了模型在训练中习得幻觉的一条此前未被考察的途径：==模型记住自己的幻觉==。
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks. We hypothesize that these decisions, while useful for reasoning, inadvertently encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in their long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks. To study this, we train models with standard post-training, extract their self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization throughout the rest of training. Our experiments on six open models across two model families and two architectures confirm our hypothesis. We find that models' recall of hallucinations reinforced during training increases by 4.83% on average, compared to just 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. In fact, models even memorize false facts that they immediately retract in their reasoning; a backtracking template inherited from reasoning-centric training that has no benefit for knowledge recall. Furthermore, we find that memorization is strongest on the hardest training questions, and rewarding a hallucination makes the model less likely to abstain from it later (by 7.23% on average). Overall, our work identifies and systematically studies a previously unexamined pathway through which models learn hallucinations during training.

papers.title: Steerable by Design: Conditional Pretraining for Robust Control of Language Models
papers.title_zh: 天生可控：面向语言模型稳健控制的条件预训练
papers.summary_zh: 在预训练阶段就引入条件控制，使指令与数据分离，让语言模型天生可控。
papers.abstract_zh: 我们的目标是构建“设计上可操控”的语言模型。今天的语言模型用下一 token 预测做预训练，把对齐和控制放在最后 1% 的训练 token 或推理时干预上。这些模型把单一输入通道同时用于指令和数据，导致常见的失败模式：模型错误地把数据当作指令，例如有意的 jailbreak 和无意的上下文对齐漂移。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种从一开始就把两者分开的预训练方法和架构，并据此得到 Mancelle-3B。一个编码器处理即将出现文本的高层语义特征，通过 cross-attention 使 token 流无法写回这个控制通道。预训练期间，模型学会依赖这些特征来预测下一个 token，使该通道成为操控模型的有效抓手。与可比的开放模型上基于提示和基于激活的方法相比，Mancelle-3B 的操控更强，同时保持流畅度，并且能抵御击败这些基线的对抗性黑盒和 soft-prompt 反向操控。我们在更受控的基线上用 Mancelle-400M 复现了这一结果。我们的结果表明，==只要尽早且有意地做，就能把稳健的控制内建到语言模型中==。
papers.abstract_en: Our goal is to build language models that are steerable by design. Today's language models are pretrained with next-token prediction, which relegates alignment and control to the final 1% of training tokens or inference-time interventions. These models repurpose a single input channel for both instructions and data, leading to common failure modes where the model mistakenly treats data as instructions such as intentional jailbreaks and unintentional in-context alignment drift. To correct this, we propose a pretraining method and architecture that separates the two from the very start, producing Mancelle-3B. An encoder processes high-level semantic features of upcoming text with cross-attention that prevents the token stream from writing back into this control channel. During pretraining, the model learns to rely on these features to predict the next token, turning the channel into an effective handle for steering the model. Mancelle-3B steers more strongly than prompt- and activation-based methods on comparable open models while maintaining fluency, and it withstands adversarial black-box and soft-prompt counter-steering that defeats those baselines. We reproduce this against a more controlled baseline with Mancelle-400M. Our results show that robust control can be built into language models if we do so early and intentionally.

papers.title: Maco-RL: Scaling Agent Capabilities with Mixed-Task Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: Maco-RL：用混合任务强化学习扩展智能体能力
papers.summary_zh: 用混合任务RL直接训练跨领域统一策略，解决规模化时的稳定性与效率问题。
papers.abstract_zh: ==混合任务强化学习==（MixRL）直接在多个领域上训练统一的策略，持续扩展 agent 的能力，无需单独训练各领域专家，也不需要额外的蒸馏阶段。尽管有这些优势，扩展 MixRL 仍面临几个挑战：实现稳定高效的混合任务学习、有效分配 rollout 计算量，以及支持持续的领域扩展。为解决这些问题，我们提出 Maco-RL，一种能有效扩展 MixRL 的方法。具体而言，Maco-RL 使用基于配额的调度器，在多个任务领域上做异步 rollout，通过平衡各领域的梯度贡献并缓解 off-policy 效应来稳定训练。在另一个正交的方向上，Maco-RL 还引入 Tri-Buffer Sampling（TBS），在掌握程度各异的样本之间分配计算量，在保留已习得能力的同时持续探索能力前沿。在五个基准上的实验显示，**Maco-RL 将 Qwen3.5-27B 的总分从 43.6 提升到 54.2，持续扩展后达到 60.1**，追上 Qwen3.8-27B 所处的前沿，并将该前沿进一步推高 +5.7。Maco-RL 在策略更新所用计算量更少的情况下，也优于单任务 RL。这些结果表明，MixRL 是一种实用且计算高效的后训练方法，在增强通用 agent 能力方面潜力很大。
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-task reinforcement learning (MixRL) directly trains a unified policy across domains to continually expand agent capabilities without training separate specialists or requiring an extra distillation stage. Despite its appeal, scaling MixRL poses significant challenges in achieving stable and efficient mixed-task learning, effectively allocating rollout compute, and supporting continual domain expansion. To address these challenges, we propose Maco-RL, an approach that effectively scales MixRL. Specifically, Maco-RL employs a quota-based scheduler for asynchronous rollouts across multiple task domains, thereby stabilizing training by balancing gradient contributions and mitigating off-policy effects. Along an orthogonal axis, Maco-RL further introduces Tri-Buffer Sampling (TBS) to allocate compute among samples with varying levels of mastery, promoting sustained frontier exploration while preserving acquired capabilities. Experiments on five benchmarks show Maco-RL raises Qwen3.5-27B's overall score from 43.6 to 54.2 and then to 60.1 with continual expansion, reaching the frontier held by Qwen3.8-27B, which is further pushed outward by +5.7. Maco-RL also outperforms single-task RL with less compute for policy updates. These results support MixRL as a practical and compute-efficient post-training approach with substantial potential to strengthen general agent capabilities.

papers.title: Learning from Recurrence: Internalizing Depth-Induced Preferences in Looped Language Models
papers.title_zh: 从递归中学习：在循环语言模型中内化深度诱导的偏好
papers.summary_zh: 让循环语言模型的共享块从更深递归深度的预测中学习。
papers.abstract_zh: Looped 语言模型在预测每个 token 之前，会把同一个 block 反复作用于隐状态，作用的次数即循环深度。增加深度能在参数量不变的情况下为每个 token 提供更多计算。共享的 block 能否从自己在更大深度上做出的预测中学习？沿用已有工作的做法，我们给预训练的 OLMo-2-1B 加上共享的循环 block，并在不同循环深度上继续 mid-training。在四次循环的模型中，额外的循环主要是在一次循环后排名已经靠前的 token 之间重新分配概率。我们用更大深度生成的续写，仅通过一次循环来训练共享 block，不使用参考答案，也不按正确性过滤。我们把这种迁移称为==偏好回写==（preference write-back）。回写进一步提高了一次循环和多次循环在多数任务上的准确率。在各自的目标深度上，更新后的模型在全部六个数学推理基准上都优于在 mid-training 数据和 token 预算上匹配的非循环对照，**各任务的平均相对准确率增益最高达 46.2%**。在带输入注入的模型上进行四次循环推理时，一次循环训练优于在相同目标上进行的全深度训练；在没有输入注入的匹配模型中，这一优势消失。在 GSM8K 上，仅在第二到第四次循环使用更新后的 block，就几乎恢复了四次循环的全部增益，说明在一次循环中学到的更新能够改善同一 block 之后的各次应用。
papers.abstract_en: A looped language model repeatedly applies the same block to its hidden state before predicting each token. The number of passes is its recurrent depth. Increasing this depth gives the model more computation per token with the same parameters. Can the shared block learn from the predictions it makes at greater depth? Following prior work, we retrofit pretrained OLMo-2-1B with a shared recurrent block and continue mid-training over varying recurrent depths. In the four-pass model, additional passes mainly redistribute probability among tokens that already rank highly after one pass. We use the continuations generated at greater depth to train only the shared block through a single pass, without reference answers or correctness filtering. We call this transfer preference write-back. Write-back further improves one-pass and multi-pass accuracy on most tasks. At their target depths, the updated models outperform a non-recurrent control matched for mid-training data and token budget on all six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, with a mean relative gain in accuracy of up to 46.2% across tasks. At four-pass inference, one-pass training outperforms full-depth training on the same targets in the model with input injection. This advantage disappears in the matched model without injection. On GSM8K, using the updated block only on passes two through four recovers nearly the entire four-pass gain, showing that an update learned in one pass can improve later applications of the same block.

papers.title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
papers.title_zh: 用 Loop Residuals 释放预训练 LLM 中循环的潜力
papers.summary_zh: 通过 Loop Residuals 把现有预训练 LLM 微调成循环模型，解决直接微调增益有限的问题。
papers.abstract_zh: Looped Transformer 通过迭代复用一组共享的层，在不增加参数的情况下增加计算量，带来更强的性能和 test-time scaling。但这种能力至今需要从零训练，而且在 LLM 上只带来有限的收益。把现有模型微调成循环结构要便宜得多，但相比 SFT 也只有微弱的增益。我们提出 ==LoopRes==，一种有效、可扩展且简单的方法，能让循环在预训练 LLM 上带来显著而稳定的收益。LoopRes 建立在 Attention Residuals 之上，让每个循环层直接 attend 到此前各次循环的输出。由于这些输出是同一组层的迭代结果，彼此越来越难以区分，我们为每次循环赋予一个可训练的、感知循环的 key，用来编码其结构身份。attend 到所有此前循环也会让各层跳过中间循环，因此我们把每层限制在最近 W 次循环构成的 residual 窗口内，迫使每次循环在最近几次循环的基础上逐步构建。在来自 3 个模型家族的 6 个预训练 LLM 和 9 个基准上，LoopRes 带来显著而稳定的增益：在 2 倍算力下，**Qwen3-1.7B-Base 比 SFT 提升 29.1%，是当前最优基线增益的两倍多**。在最大 30B 的更大模型和全部三个家族上，增益依然成立。更重要的是，从 1.7B 到 8B，随着算力增加，LoopRes 的扩展比 SFT 更陡，上限更高，并且在长输出上所需算力更少。这些结果表明 LoopRes 是一种有效的循环方法，同时带来更好的性能和更好的 test-time scaling。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling. However, this power has so far required training from scratch and yielded only modest gains for LLMs. Finetuning existing models into loops is far cheaper, yet also brings only marginal gains over SFT. We propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs. Building on Attention Residuals, LoopRes lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops. Since these outputs are iterates of the same layers and become harder to tell apart, we give each a trainable loop-aware key that encodes its structural identity. Attending to all earlier loops also lets layers skip intermediate ones, so we restrict each layer to a residual window of the latest W loops, forcing every loop to build incrementally on recent ones. Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 benchmarks, LoopRes delivers significant and consistent gains: at 2x compute, it improves Qwen3-1.7B-Base by 29.1% over SFT, more than doubling the gain of the state-of-the-art baseline. The gains hold on larger models up to 30B and across all three families. More importantly, from 1.7B to 8B, LoopRes scales more steeply than SFT as compute grows, reaching a higher ceiling while needing less compute on long outputs. These results establish LoopRes as an effective looping approach, delivering both better performance and better test-time scaling.

papers.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
papers.summary_zh: 重新设计循环 Transformer 中相邻循环之间传递的内容，兼顾表达力与效率。
papers.abstract_zh: Looped Transformer 通过在多次循环中复用共享层来提升表达能力，但代价是效率。要推进其表达能力与效率的前沿，需要重新思考连接相邻循环的核心机制：Transformer 循环时应该传递什么？我们提出 ==Mixture-of-Loops Transformer（MoLT）==，其 Mixture-of-Loops Attention（MoLA）把 key 和 value（KV）当作记忆，在不同深度和循环之间选择性复用。在 loop residual 下，MoLT-R 保留 residual stream，并跨循环读取局部 KV 以获得表达能力。在 loop KV 下，MoLT-KV 则从 embedding 重新开始，在较早位置读取前序循环的记忆 KV，并读取当前循环的局部 KV，以获得效率。MoLT-KV 消除了同一位置上的跨循环依赖，配合用于并行训练的 loop forcing，可以实现超出训练循环范围的单次遍历 Mixture-of-Loops（MoL）解码。为平衡效率与质量，我们提出 U-shaped MoLT（U-MoLT），它把记忆构建与预测读出分开，并在不改变预测的前提下跳过未使用的 decoder 遍历。在 400B token 的预训练中，U-MoLT 在 700M/1.5B dense 和 3B MoE 模型上都优于 OLMo3，**在 700M 上达到 1.7 倍的验证 cross-entropy（CE）token 效率**，同时把 3B MoE 的 10 个领域 perplexity 改善 0.75，10 项任务准确率提高 2.1 个百分点。在对 Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base 做 100B token 的持续预训练中，我们的 U-MoLT 适配在全部 11 个领域上都比匹配的基线降低了 CE，平均 token 效率为 1.4 倍。在推理时，U-MoLT 配合 MoL-Hybrid-2 在 S 规模（约 113M）模型上与非循环的 OLMo3 延迟持平，分别为 996.6 ms 和 1,000.6 ms。代码见 https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT

papers.title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
papers.title_zh: 让模型自己管理上下文：现状如何
papers.summary_zh: 在 NVIDIA 开源 Agent 框架中比较模型自主压缩上下文与框架触发压缩。
papers.abstract_zh: 目前的 agent harness 代替模型管理上下文：窗口填满时，harness 触发一次 compaction，对历史进行摘要。我们研究另一种方案，即==模型驱动的上下文管理==：由模型自己通过 context API 决定何时压缩、压缩什么。我们在 NVIDIA 的开源 agent harness \nooa 中让模型控制自己的上下文，并在文档研究和机器学习工程任务上，针对 8K 到 512K token 的上下文预算，对两种策略做了比较。能有效使用 context API 的模型可以达到更高的准确率，且常常消耗更少的输入 token，在预算紧张时尤其如此：**GPT 6.1 在 32K 预算下的得分几乎是原来的三倍**（OfficeQA Pro v2 上从 21% 升至 56%），**Kimi 的输入 token 最多减少 41%**，同时准确率还有提升。不过，各模型使用 API 的频率、压缩的激进程度和开始压缩的时机差别很大，改动提示词也会改变压缩时机。最后我们表明，推理引擎可以让模型驱动的编辑更便宜：编辑之后复用未变化后缀的 KV cache，每个请求的 prefill 计算量最多可减少 15%，准确率没有可测量的变化。这些结果指向一个新的协同设计方向：训练能管理自身上下文的模型，并配以支持 KV cache 编辑的推理引擎。
papers.abstract_en: Agent harnesses today manage context on the model's behalf: when the window fills, the harness triggers a compaction that summarizes the history. We study the alternative, \emph{model-driven} context management, in which the model itself decides when and what to compact through a context API. We gave models control over their own context in \nooa, NVIDIA's open source agent harness, and compared the two strategies on document research and machine learning engineering across context budgets from 8K to 512K tokens. Models that use the context API effectively reach higher accuracy, often with fewer input tokens, especially at tight budgets: \textbf{GPT 6.1 nearly triples its score at a 32K budget} on OfficeQA Pro v2 (21\%~$\rightarrow$~56\%), and \textbf{Kimi gains with up to 41\% fewer input tokens}. Models differ widely, however, in how often they use the API, how aggressively they compact, and when they start compacting, and prompt changes shift that timing. Finally, we show that \textbf{inference engines can make model-driven edits cheaper}: by reusing the KV cache of the unchanged suffix after an edit, \textbf{we cut prefill compute by up to 15\% per request with no measurable change in accuracy}. Together, these results point to a new co-design frontier: models trained to manage their own context, served by inference engines that support KV cache editing.

papers.title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
papers.title_zh: 当所有 rollout 都失败：向长程 Agent 强化学习拼接以学习者为条件的 option
papers.summary_zh: 针对长程任务中整组 rollout 全部零奖励的问题，拼接以学习者为条件的 option 提供信号。
papers.abstract_zh: 在长程 agent 任务上，基于分组的可验证奖励强化学习常常出现全失败组：每条采样轨迹的奖励都为零，使得组相对方法没有基于奖励的策略梯度可用。常见的补救办法是由更强的模型提供完整解答，但完整轨迹成本高，还会让学习者面对很长的 off-policy 历史。我们提出 SPLICE，它在线地从当前策略失败的轨迹构造局部训练目标。对每个全失败组，proposal 模型在一条当前策略轨迹上选定一个拼接点，并从该点生成若干有界的 option。我们用当前策略的多次重复续写估计每个 option 的价值，把正的估计值转换成按回报加权的局部目标，并在这些 option 上拟合当前策略。我们在两个策略系列、两个长程 agent 任务上评估 ==SPLICE==：基于 SWE-bench Verified 的软件工程，以及基于 BrowseComp-Plus 的深度研究。SPLICE 在全部四种设置下都优于 GRPO 和完整轨迹引导基线，**相比 GRPO 提升 2.8 至 9.8 个百分点**。在最初失败的 SWE 任务上，它把 GRPO 的毕业率提高了 10.8 个百分点。进一步的实验表明，SPLICE 在提升性能的同时，减少了代价高昂的 proposal 模型计算。
papers.abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.
